crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

translations.web: “ ‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.
translations.bsb: You must not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s close relative.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
